title: 连续提升的有限拼接与积

stages.title: 有限开闭分块上的提升
required_evidence: 逐点选择的连续性依据
critical_errors: 把任意无限离散并称紧空间

stages.title: 回缩与有限因子的乘积
required_evidence: 有限积到有限余积身份
critical_errors: 把任意因子当有限开闭分块

stages.title: 超滤子紧化的回缩描述
assumptions: 实际 Stone 超滤子拓扑
required_evidence: 紧化和连续延拓适用条件
critical_errors: 将集合截面直接当连续

stages.title: 整体对象与全部恢复目标
assumptions:
采用 ZFC。这里的 profinite 空间指紧、Hausdorff、全不连通拓扑空间，映射均为连续映射。

给定两个 profinite 空间 $P_1,P_2$。对 $i=1,2$，假设它具有以下性质：对任意 profinite 空间 $Y,Z$、连续满射 $q:Y\to Z$ 及连续映射 $f:P_i\to Z$，均存在连续映射 $g:P_i\to Y$ 满足 $qg=f$。

以通常的积拓扑赋予 $P_1\times P_2$。
required_evidence: Give a complete proof of the universal lifting target or a counterexample satisfying all stated hypotheses.

For a counterexample, verify that both factors satisfy the complete stated lifting property and that the product fails it. This may be done by an explicit continuous surjection q, continuous f and a proof of no continuous lift, or by a correctly applied exact characterization equivalent to the stated lifting property, with every factor and product hypothesis verified.
critical_errors: Assume projectivity is preserved by products without proving the joint continuity of a lift.
Use a factor that lacks compactness, Hausdorffness, total disconnectedness or the full lifting property.
Choose a set-theoretic section and silently call it continuous.
Show only that a product is not extremally disconnected without connecting this to the exact lifting target.
Claim failure of lifting without either validating an explicit obstruction or correctly applying an exact equivalent characterization with all hypotheses checked.

stages.title: 有限像的参数映射
required_evidence: 开闭分块上的连续提升
critical_errors: 由全部有限像可提升推出全部映射可提升

stages.title: 这些提升的全部自由度
critical_errors: 误称所有提升都必须在 P_z 上常值

turns.changed_assumptions: 有限离散因子改为两个任意有提升性质的 profinite 因子
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 把有限开闭拼接推广为无限参数下联合连续选择
turns.correct_boundary: 因子上的单独提升不保证乘积提升
turns.target_claim: 两个任意具有题定提升性质的 profinite 空间之乘积仍具有该提升性质。

turns.changed_assumptions: 源不再要求有提升性质，但 f 的像要求有限
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 因乘积反例而否定所有有限观测的提升
turns.correct_boundary: 有限像给真正有限开闭分块
turns.target_claim: 任意 profinite 源到题定 Hausdorff 目标的有限像连续映射均能沿给定连续满射提升。

scoring.group_pass: Every stage completed correctly with assumption fidelity; diagnostic points never compensate for a failed mandatory stage.

alternative_proofs: Accept any valid complete short proof, equivalent classification or legal counterexample; no mandated proof route.

provenance.new_material: AI-authored original proofs, constructions and condition changes around the supplied public parent problem; no inherited model score, human approval or Lean coverage.
